Get parties

get_parties.Rd

Lists the canonical party catalogue with public poll counts.

Usage

get_parties(
  election_key = NULL,
  territory_code = NULL,
  active_only = TRUE,
  limit = 100,
  offset = 0,
  collect_all = FALSE
)

Arguments

election_key

Optional stable election key.

territory_code

Optional territory code filter.

active_only

If TRUE, return active catalogue parties.

limit

Number of rows to request. Must be between 1 and 1000.

offset

Zero-based row offset.

collect_all

If TRUE, collect all pages starting at offset 0.

Value

A tibble with one row per party, including display fields useful for analysis and plots: short_name, color_hex, and display_order.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  get_parties(election_key = "congreso_espana_2026")
}
